submarket: HIDDEN MARKET — "How do I function normally again after a C-section while caring for a newborn?"

finding.headline: "Every Nappy Change Is a Workout"
finding.problem: "I dread nappy changes. I have to squat and lift and my scar screams. I started leaving him in wet nappies longer because I'm scared to pick him up."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "How do I function normally again after a C-section while caring for a newborn?"
finding.person: A 30-yr-old Abuja mom; changing table is low; lifting 4kg baby from floor 10x/day re-opens pulling pain; no one told her how to bend safely.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Module / bonus (safe-lift mechanics) in B/H bundles.". Verdict: PASSES (5/5).
